Evaluate differential-functioning contrasts and bias screens in simulations

Source: R/api-simulation.R
evaluate_mfrm_signal_detection.Rd

Evaluate differential-functioning contrasts and bias screens in simulations

Summarize a DIF/bias screening simulation

Usage

evaluate_mfrm_signal_detection(
  n_person = c(30, 50, 100),
  n_rater = c(4),
  n_criterion = c(4),
  raters_per_person = n_rater,
  design = NULL,
  reps = 10,
  group_levels = c("A", "B"),
  reference_group = NULL,
  focal_group = NULL,
  dif_level = NULL,
  dif_effect = 0.6,
  bias_rater = NULL,
  bias_criterion = NULL,
  bias_effect = -0.8,
  score_levels = 4,
  theta_sd = 1,
  rater_sd = 0.35,
  criterion_sd = 0.25,
  noise_sd = 0,
  step_span = 1.4,
  fit_method = c("JML", "MML"),
  model = c("RSM", "PCM", "GPCM"),
  step_facet = NULL,
  slope_facet = NULL,
  slopes = NULL,
  maxit = 25,
  quad_points = 7,
  residual_pca = c("none", "overall", "facet", "both"),
  sim_spec = NULL,
  dif_method = c("residual", "refit"),
  dif_min_obs = 10,
  dif_p_adjust = "holm",
  dif_p_cut = 0.05,
  dif_abs_cut = 0.43,
  bias_max_iter = 2,
  bias_p_cut = 0.05,
  bias_abs_t = 2,
  seed = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_signal_detection'
summary(object, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_signal_detection'
plot(
  x,
  signal = c("dif", "bias"),
  metric = c("power", "false_positive", "estimate", "screen_rate",
    "screen_false_positive"),
  x_var = c("n_person", "n_rater", "n_criterion", "raters_per_person"),
  group_var = NULL,
  draw = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

n_person

Vector of person counts to evaluate.

n_rater

Vector of rater counts to evaluate.

n_criterion

Vector of criterion counts to evaluate.

raters_per_person

Vector of rater assignments per person.

design

Optional named design-grid override supplied as a named list, named vector, or one-row data frame. Names may use canonical variables (n_person, n_rater, n_criterion, raters_per_person), current public aliases implied by sim_spec (for example n_judge, n_task, judge_per_person), or role keywords (person, rater, criterion, assignment). Values may be vectors. The nested named-facet form design$facets = c(person = ..., judge = ..., task = ...) is also accepted for the supported person/rater/criterion design. Do not specify the same variable through both design and the scalar design-grid arguments.

reps

Number of replications per design condition.

group_levels

Group labels used for DIF simulation. The first two levels define the default reference and focal groups. If omitted, inherits the groups stored in sim_spec, when present.

reference_group

Optional reference group label used when extracting the target DIF contrast.

focal_group

Optional focal group label used when extracting the target DIF contrast.

dif_level

Target criterion level for the true DIF effect. Can be an integer index or a criterion label such as "C04". Defaults to the last criterion level in each design.

dif_effect

True DIF effect size added to the focal group on the target criterion's linear predictor. For GPCM, discrimination multiplies this shift in the adjacent-category log odds.

bias_rater

Target rater level for the true interaction-bias effect. Can be an integer index or a label such as "R04". Defaults to the last rater level in each design.

bias_criterion

Target criterion level for the true interaction-bias effect. Can be an integer index or a criterion label. Defaults to the last criterion level in each design.

bias_effect

True interaction-bias effect added to the target Rater x Criterion cell's linear predictor, with the same GPCM scaling.

score_levels

Number of ordered score categories.

theta_sd

Standard deviation of simulated person measures.

rater_sd

Standard deviation of simulated rater severities.

criterion_sd

Standard deviation of simulated criterion difficulties.

noise_sd

Optional observation-level noise added to the linear predictor.

step_span

Spread of step thresholds on the logit scale.

fit_method

Estimation method passed to fit_mfrm().

model

Measurement model passed to fit_mfrm(). GPCM is supported with caveats as slope-aware signal-detection sensitivity evidence.

step_facet

Step facet passed to fit_mfrm() when model = "PCM" or model = "GPCM". When left NULL, the function inherits the generator step facet from sim_spec when available and otherwise defaults to "Criterion".

slope_facet

Slope facet passed to fit_mfrm() when model = "GPCM". Defaults to the fitted step facet.

slopes

Optional GPCM slope specification used by direct simulation calls when sim_spec = NULL.

maxit

Maximum iterations passed to fit_mfrm().

quad_points

Quadrature points for fit_method = "MML".

residual_pca

Residual PCA mode passed to diagnose_mfrm().

sim_spec

Optional output from build_mfrm_sim_spec() or extract_mfrm_sim_spec() used as the base data-generating mechanism. When supplied, the design grid still varies n_person, n_rater, n_criterion, and raters_per_person, but latent spread, thresholds, and other generator settings come from sim_spec. The target DIF and interaction-bias signals specified in this function override any signal tables stored in sim_spec. If sim_spec stores an active latent-regression population generator, this helper currently requires fit_method = "MML" so each replication can refit the population model.

dif_method

Differential-functioning method passed to analyze_dff().

dif_min_obs

Minimum observations per group cell for analyze_dff().

dif_p_adjust

P-value adjustment method passed to analyze_dff(). Target and non-target screens use the returned adjusted tail areas; an unavailable adjusted value never falls back to an unadjusted one.

dif_p_cut

P-value cutoff for counting a target DIF detection.

dif_abs_cut

Optional absolute contrast cutoff used when counting a target DIF detection. When omitted, the effective default is 0.43 for dif_method = "refit" and 0 (no additional magnitude cutoff) for dif_method = "residual".

bias_max_iter

Maximum iterations passed to estimate_bias().

bias_p_cut

P-value cutoff for counting a target bias screen-positive result.

bias_abs_t

Absolute t cutoff for counting a target bias screen-positive result.

seed

Optional seed for reproducible replications. Trial seeds are allocated before execution and cover generation, fitting and diagnostics. A supplied seed preserves the caller's RNG state.

object

Output from evaluate_mfrm_signal_detection().

digits

Number of digits used when printing numeric summaries.

...

Reserved for generic compatibility.

x

Output from evaluate_mfrm_signal_detection().

signal

Whether to plot DIF or bias screening results.

metric

Metric to plot. For signal = "bias", prefer metric = "screen_rate" for the screening hit rate. The older metric = "power" spelling is retained as a backwards-compatible alias that maps to BiasScreenRate. "estimate" plots the signed reference-minus-focal DIF contrast or the additive bias shift. A refit contrast requires common-scale linking.

x_var

Design variable used on the x-axis. When x was generated from a sim_spec with custom public facet names, the corresponding aliases (for example n_judge, n_task, judge_per_person) are also accepted. Role keywords (person, rater, criterion, assignment) are accepted as an abstraction over the current two-facet schema.

group_var

Optional design variable used for separate lines. The same alias rules as x_var apply.

draw

If TRUE, print the ggplot object; otherwise return the ggplot object invisibly without drawing.

Value

An object of class mfrm_signal_detection with:

  • design_grid: evaluated design conditions. When sim_spec carries custom public facet names, matching design-variable alias columns are included alongside the standard result columns.

  • results: replicate-level detection results, with the same design-variable alias columns when applicable. Seed identifies the trial; DIFReferenceGroup, DIFFocalGroup, DIFContrastDirection and DIFContrastScale identify its contrast. DIFScreenReason and BiasScreenReason retain target-level unavailability explanations.

  • rep_overview: run-level status and timing, with the same design-variable alias columns when applicable, including failed attempts and their stage.

  • design_descriptor: role-based design-variable metadata used by planning summaries and plots

  • planning_scope: explicit record of the current planning contract

  • planning_constraints: explicit record of which design variables remain mutable under the current simulation specification

  • planning_schema: structured planning metadata bundling the role descriptor, scope boundary, and current mutability map

  • gpcm_boundary: GPCM caveat row when a GPCM screening route is used

  • settings: signal-analysis settings

  • ademp: simulation-study metadata (aims, DGM, estimands, methods, performance measures)

  • notes: short interpretation notes

An object of class summary.mfrm_signal_detection with:

  • overview: run-level overview

  • detection_summary: full-precision rates by design, with design-variable aliases when applicable. DIF*, DIFClass* and BiasScreen* columns retain Planned, Available, Unavailable, Positive, MCLower, MCUpper, AllTrialsLower and AllTrialsUpper for target outcomes. Monte Carlo bounds are exact 95% binomial intervals conditional on availability; all-trial bounds describe unresolved outcomes, not confidence intervals. DIFNonTarget*/BiasNonTarget* retain summed Planned and Available cell counts and AvailableReps, the number of trials contributing a non-target proportion. Those proportions receive equal weight across contributing trials, even with unequal cell counts; their MCSE is the sample SD of the proportions divided by the square root of AvailableReps. TargetContrastAvailable, TargetContrastAbsAvailable, TargetBiasAvailable and TargetBiasTAvailable are denominators for the corresponding finite point summaries. All-missing means return NA.

  • ademp: simulation-study metadata carried forward from the original object

  • facet_names: public facet labels carried from the simulation specification

  • design_variable_aliases: accepted public aliases for design variables

  • design_descriptor: role-based design-variable metadata

  • planning_scope: explicit record of the current planning contract

  • planning_constraints: explicit record of mutable/locked design variables

  • planning_schema: structured planning metadata

  • structural_design_review: deterministic structural review of the named-facet design grid; it reports design bookkeeping rather than signal-detection performance

  • gpcm_boundary: GPCM caveat row when present

  • notes: short interpretation notes, including the bias-side screening caveat

For plot(): Invisibly, a ggplot object whose reusable payload (accessible via plot_data()) includes resolved canonical variables (x_var, group_var) together with public labels (x_label, group_label), design_variable_aliases, design_descriptor, planning_scope, planning_constraints, planning_schema, display_metric, and interpretation_note so callers can label bias-side plots as screening summaries rather than formal power/error-rate displays. summary_table retains per-design means and availability denominators; notes retains interpretation and legacy-result restrictions. If additional design variables are collapsed, each plotted point is an equally weighted average of available design-level means, not a pooled trial/cell rate.

Details

Injects Group \(\times\) Criterion dif_effect and Rater \(\times\) Criterion bias_effect shifts (multiplied by slope in GPCM with slope_facet == step_facet) and evaluates analyze_dff() and estimate_bias() across replications. Because current residual and refit analyze_dff() routes return descriptive contrasts (DIFContrast as reference minus focal; DIFContrastComparable flags common-scale linking) without calibrated p-values, DIF detection and false-positive rates remain NA.

Bias cells count as screen-positive (BiasScreenRate) when both screening metrics are available and satisfy \(p \le\) bias_p_cut and \(|t| \ge\) bias_abs_t (NA when unavailable, never coerced to FALSE). Non-target false-positive averages (BiasNonTarget*) and exact binomial Monte Carlo plus unresolved-outcome bounds describe simulation replications rather than calibrated familywise alpha; see mfrm_screening_performance() for complete-roster per-target and any-target summaries.

plot() method: Plot DIF/bias screening simulation results

References

See "References" in evaluate_mfrm_design() for the Monte Carlo/ADEMP framework (Morris et al., 2019; Siepe et al., 2024). This helper applies that framework to DIF and interaction-bias screens; it does not reproduce a published many-facet simulation design.

Examples

# Long-running workflow; run explicitly when needed.
# example("evaluate_mfrm_signal_detection", run.dontrun = TRUE)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sig_eval <- suppressWarnings(evaluate_mfrm_signal_detection(
  design = list(person = 8, rater = 2, criterion = 2, assignment = 2),
  reps = 1,
  maxit = 30,
  bias_max_iter = 1,
  seed = 123
))
s_sig <- summary(sig_eval)
s_sig$overview
} # }
# Optional workflow; run the example explicitly as shown below.
# example("summary.mfrm_signal_detection", run.dontrun = TRUE)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# One saved replication illustrates output structure, not precise rates.
# Regeneration recipe: examples/simulation-results.R in the package.
saved <- readRDS(system.file("examples", "simulation-signal-detection.rds",
  package = "mfrmr", mustWork = TRUE))
# Inspect saved$generation_warnings and the result's run/status tables.
sig_eval <- saved$result
summary(sig_eval)
} # }
# Long-running workflow; run explicitly when needed.
# example("plot.mfrm_signal_detection", run.dontrun = TRUE)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# One saved replication illustrates output structure, not precise rates.
# Regeneration recipe: examples/simulation-results.R in the package.
saved <- readRDS(system.file("examples", "simulation-signal-detection.rds",
  package = "mfrmr", mustWork = TRUE))
# Inspect saved$generation_warnings and the result's run/status tables.
sig_eval <- saved$result
plot(sig_eval, signal = "dif", metric = "power", x_var = "n_person", draw = FALSE)
} # }
